notes.courtyard: No recommended loadout or fixed supply per length on wiki. Courtyard page: 'One stack of Torches should suffice for a typical venture in the Courtyard'; 'Firewood will not be given at the beginning of an Epic quest' (Wine Crate + shovel is only Courtyard firewood source); bring a reserve of The Blood; holy water, bandages, shovels, herbs useful; antivenom less important; avoid skeleton keys on chests. No quantities except torches. ludo.guide (third-party) suggests 'three sets' of The Blood for boss quests. Sources: https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Courtyard , https://www.ludo.guide/guide/darkest-dungeon/courtyard
notes.farmstead: No recommended loadout/fixed supply on wiki. Farmstead page: 'No Firewood will be given for any Farmstead expedition' (camp at Miller's Hearth); most useful provisions are Food (for camping) and Skeleton Keys (Stockpile); 'There is no need to bring Torches or Shovels.' Source: https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/Farmstead
notes.general: Provisions page gives no per-dungeon recommendations; only firewood by length: Short 0, Medium 1, Long 2. Source: https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/Provisions

lengths.courtyard: Not standard short/medium/long board quests. Fixed quest set: 'Burn the Hives' = short, Novice tier (first quest); 3 boss quests (Morbid Entertainment / Served Cold / A Bewitching Predator) = Epic length, very large maps, cost an Invitation, no firewood given; 'Gather the Blood' (repeatable, Winemaker's Reserves) and 'Slay the Garden Guardian' described as 'more or less normal' with no length on wiki. ludo.guide calls Gather the Blood 'Short L5' and Hives 'Short L1'. Sources: https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Courtyard , https://www.ludo.guide/guide/darkest-dungeon/courtyard
lengths.farmstead: No short/medium/long. Wave-based: Apprentice = single wave group, no boss, wave ends after 20 kills; Veteran = single wave group ending with The Miller boss; Endless Harvest = repeatable endless waves until defeat/flee. Waves (~10 kills each) with rooms (curios) between; most wave groups = 2-3 waves + boss. Source: https://darkestdungeon.wiki.gg/wiki/Farmstead
